title: LLMsSpark: A Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Strategic Gaming Contexts
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark, LLMsPark, measures strategic and social behaviors in game-theoretic contexts. It does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a part of its investigation.
